        private global::SourceFlow.Reaction Step(TSelf current, SimulationInput input, JsonSerializerOptions serializer, global::SourceFlow.ReactionContext<global::SourceFlow.Workflows.WorkflowInstanceId> context)
        {
            if (current.State is null)
            {
                return global::SourceFlow.Reaction.Ignore;   // not started
            }

            SimulationState state = SimulationStateJson.Read(_workflow, current.State, _options);
            if (context.Now > state.Now)
            {
                state.Now = context.Now;
            }

            return Apply(WorkflowSimulator.Step(state, input), serializer, context);
        }

        private global::SourceFlow.Reaction Apply(SimulationResult result, JsonSerializerOptions serializer, global::SourceFlow.ReactionContext<global::SourceFlow.Workflows.WorkflowInstanceId> context)
        {
            if (result.Effects.All(e => e.Kind == SimulationEffect.Ignored))
            {
                return global::SourceFlow.Reaction.Ignore;
            }

            global::SourceFlow.Reaction reaction = global::SourceFlow.Reaction.Become(TSelf.FromState(SimulationStateJson.Write(result.State)));
            string instance = result.State.Instance;
            foreach (SimulationEffect effect in result.Effects)
            {
                if (effect.Command is { } sent)
                {
                    string json = SimulationStateJson.ToJson(sent.Fields.ToDictionary(f => f.Key, f => f.Value, StringComparer.Ordinal));
                    reaction = reaction.AndSend(_command(sent.Command, json, serializer), new global::SourceFlow.MessageId(sent.MessageId));
                }
                else if (effect.Kind == SimulationEffect.Schedule && effect.Timer is { } timer)
                {
                    reaction = reaction.Schedule(new global::SourceFlow.Workflows.WorkflowTimer(_process, instance, timer.Kind, timer.Step, timer.Attempt), timer.Due);
                }
            }

            foreach (SimulationTransition transition in result.Transitions)
            {
                reaction = reaction.AndRecord(new global::SourceFlow.Workflows.WorkflowTransition(transition.Kind, transition.Step, transition.Attempt));
            }

            return result.State.IsTerminal ? reaction.AndComplete() : reaction;
        }

        private static Dictionary<string, object?> Read(global::SourceFlow.IMessage message, JsonSerializerOptions serializer)
        {
            JsonElement element = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(message, serializer.GetTypeInfo(message.GetType()));
            var data = new Dictionary<string, object?>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            if (element.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object)
            {
                foreach (JsonProperty property in element.EnumerateObject())
                {
                    data[property.Name] = Value(property.Value);
                }
            }

            return data;
        }

        private static object? Value(JsonElement element)
        {
            switch (element.ValueKind)
            {
                case JsonValueKind.String: return element.GetString();
                case JsonValueKind.Number: return element.TryGetDecimal(out decimal d) ? d : (decimal)element.GetDouble();
                case JsonValueKind.True: return true;
                case JsonValueKind.False: return false;
                case JsonValueKind.Array: return element.EnumerateArray().Select(Value).ToList();
                case JsonValueKind.Object:
                    var map = new Dictionary<string, object?>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
                    foreach (JsonProperty property in element.EnumerateObject())
                    {
                        map[property.Name] = Value(property.Value);
                    }

                    return map;
                default: return null;
            }
        }
